intro_paragraphs: AC failures and heating emergencies do not wait for Monday. If you searched hvac open sunday no extra charge or sunday ac repair Raleigh NC, you already know the problem: many companies are closed, and the ones that answer often add weekend premiums. Frost Fire Heating and Cooling is different — we are open Sundays, and we charge the same fair rates as weekdays.

That promise covers residential AC and heating emergencies as well as commercial calls like walk-in coolers and rooftop units. Based in Clayton and serving the Triangle, we built our schedule around real life: families home on weekends, restaurants open for brunch, and systems that fail when it is hottest or coldest.
Need help today? Call (919) 230-4439 or request service online. For urgent failures, see our 24/7 emergency HVAC page.
